t: You're looking at Fortnum and Mason, the upmarket department store at 181 Piccadilly, in St James's. The shop was established here in 1707 by William Fortnum and Hugh Mason, and Hugh Mason is remembered as a grocer. Charles Fortnum, who was both a royal servant and a grocer, is also counted among its founders. Today there are other branches, including the Royal Exchange, St Pancras station, Canary Wharf and Heathrow. Since 1951 the company has been privately owned by Wittington Investments.
